title: Washington Post reporter hunts for information on the psychic spying program

tellings.quote: started covering hunting for information on the psychic buying program

plain: At some point between the 1970s and the 1990s, a reporter at the Washington Post began hunting for information about the US government's program to use psychics for spying. Joe McMoneagle, who worked as one of the program's psychic spies, tells Michels this, but does not name the reporter or say what the reporter found. It matters because press interest like this is how a secret program can come out into the open.
